::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[Beamer and newenvironments](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/6610/beamer-and-newenvironments), asked by [Chris](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/752/chris) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-12-06; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> I'm trying to combine beamer overlays and newenvironments:
>
> ```latex
> \newcounter{scount}
> \setcounter{scount}{0}
> \newenvironment{sitem}[1]
>    {%before
>    \def\data{#1}
>    \stepcounter{scount}
>    \onslide<\value{scount}->{\item \data}
>    \comment
>    }{
>    \endcomment
>    }
> ```
>
> and:
>
> ```latex
> \begin{itemize}
>   \begin{sitem}{data}asdf1\end{sitem}
>   \begin{sitem}{data}asdf2\end{sitem}
>   \begin{sitem}{data}asdf3\end{sitem}
> \end{itemize}
> ```
>
> But beamer seems to ignore the \onslide command and shows all data values at once instead of data for asdf1, asdf2, asdf3 after each other.
:::

I'm not sure if this is the cause of the unexpected behavior, but you can eliminate the extra counter with incremental overlay specifications.

```latex
\newenvironment{sitem}[1]
   {%before
     \item<+-> #1
     \comment
   }{
     \endcomment
   }
```
